graduation_reaches_liquidity_phase.meaning: the token graduation has proceeded to the liquidity addition phase where _createPairAndSwapRemaining() is invoked

pairfor_salt_param_count.meaning: number of parameters used by Launchpad::pairFor to build the CREATE2 salt (token0, token1)

createpair_salt_param_count.meaning: number of parameters used by GTELaunchpadV2PairFactory::createPair to build the CREATE2 salt when msg.sender == launchpad (token0, token1, launchpadLp, launchpadFeeDistributor)

skim_target_is_existing_pair.meaning: the address returned by pairFor() on which _createPairAndSwapRemaining() calls skim() is an existing deployed pair contract
skim_target_is_existing_pair.checkpoint: at skim() call during liquidity addition phase

tokens_stuck_in_bonding_phase.meaning: tokens remain permanently stuck in the bonding phase because graduation cannot complete (permanent DoS)

assumptions: The graduation flow reaches _createPairAndSwapRemaining() on a normal (non-attacker) graduation operation, as the report describes failure regardless of attacker involvement.
The pair factory's createPair is invoked with msg.sender == launchpad during graduation, matching the 4-parameter salt branch.

unresolved.description: Report does not provide the concrete CREATE2 address values or the exact salt encoding, so the inequality between pairFor()'s computed address and the deployed pair address cannot be expressed numerically; only the salt parameter counts (2 vs 4) are grounded.

limitations: The direct address mismatch (pairFor address != deployed pair address) is represented only via the grounded salt parameter counts and the skim-target observable, not via concrete address values.
The tokens-stuck impact is encoded as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric magnitude for stuck tokens.
Only the permanent_dos_tokens_stuck impact is formalized here; all_graduations_fail is handled in a separate claim-generation pass.
